events.title: Wednesday Bible Study
events.description: A midweek study working verse-by-verse through a book of the Bible. Open to all — first-timers welcome.

events.title: Youth Night
events.description: Weekly gathering for middle and high schoolers — games, snacks, a short message, and small-group discussion.

events.title: Women's Group
events.description: Weekly Bible study and conversation for women of every age. Childcare provided.

events.title: Men's Breakfast
events.description: Free monthly breakfast and short message for the men of the church and community. First Saturday of the month.
